svg.aria-label: 1. CourseMatch AI. One advisor instead of fifteen browser tabs. An agentic course advisor for University of Waterloo students: 33 tools, 3 tiered LLMs, 6,700+ course catalogs. Built with Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, pgvector, React.
